To **Purchase** a NetZoom product or service, first select the product from the Products and Services list. Next select the options in the middle pane and click *Add to Cart*. Repeat the process for additional items. Once you have added your order to the cart, complete the Checkout process by clicking *Checkout* and filling in the purchase form and click *Submit Order*.
Use **My Requests** to track the status of NetZoom Device Library or Visio stencil shape requests.
Use **Request Support** to communicate with the technical support team.
Use the **Visio Stencils** pane to browse and search the Visio Stencils library for specific Visio stencil shapes. Request and Download panes will support stencil request workflows.
Use the **Device Model** pane to browse and search the NetZoom device library for your desired manufacturer-specific shapes. Request and Download panes will support shape request workflows.
